code: /** Order defs by a persisted id list: known ids first (in persisted order), then any defs not in the list (new tabs) appended in their canonical order; stale ids in the list are ignored. */ export function orderTabs(defs, order) { if (!order || order.length === 0) return defs; var byId = new Map(defs.map(function(d) { return [d.id, d]; })); var out = []; for (var i = 0; i < order.length; i++) { var d = byId.get(order[i]); if (d) { out.push(d); byId.delete(order[i]); } } for (var j = 0; j < defs.length; j++) { if (byId.has(defs[j].id)) out.push(defs[j]); } return out; }
